args: case "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) PY=.venv/Scripts/python.exe; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=.venv-win/Scripts/python.exe; if [ -x "$PY" ]; then exec "$PY" scripts/nautilus_mcp_server.py "$@"; fi; exec uv run --no-sync python scripts/nautilus_mcp_server.py "$@";; *) PY=.venv/bin/python; if [ -x "$PY" ]; then exec "$PY" scripts/nautilus_mcp_server.py "$@"; fi; exec uv run --no-sync python scripts/nautilus_mcp_server.py "$@";; esac

case "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) ED=.venv/Scripts/edgartools-mcp.exe; [ -x "$ED" ] || ED=.venv-win/Scripts/edgartools-mcp.exe; if [ -x "$ED" ]; then exec "$ED" "$@"; fi; exec uv run --no-sync edgartools-mcp "$@";; *) ED=.venv/bin/edgartools-mcp; if [ -x "$ED" ]; then exec "$ED" "$@"; fi; exec uv run --no-sync edgartools-mcp "$@";; esac

hooks.command: bash -c 'case "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) [ -d .venv/Scripts ] && PATH=".venv/Scripts:$PATH"; [ -d "$HOME/.local/bin" ] && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH";; *) [ -d .venv/bin ] && PATH=".venv/bin:$PATH"; [ -d "$HOME/.local/bin" ] && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH";; esac; if ! OUT=$(ruff check src tests scripts 2>&1 && ast-grep scan 2>&1); then printf "%s\n" "$OUT" >&2; exit 2; fi'
